meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.

A rewrite of what, Hale, and on what evidence? Taking it now would mean admitting something, and I haven't been shown a single document. Answer my question first: who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents, Hale. Generous for what? You still haven't shown me one document, and you haven't told me who decided on the zero.
Will you take it or not?
Not until I've seen what it's based on, Hale. You've given me a yes-or-no with no evidence and no answer on who decided the zero. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen's essay stand until you show me evidence I can check, that you tell me who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard first, and that you apologise for how he found out. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided it, so this is not yet the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, though you did offer exactly that and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you offered the rewrite and the clean record without a single document she could read or check.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then pressed her for a yes or no, which let her treat accepting as an admission and kept the missing call home unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and even if it had, it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then show one dated document she can check before you put the rewrite on the table.
